product.ta-bitsy-2.summary: The BITSY 2 was a word-processing workstation with an external dual drive.
product.ta-bitsy-2.history: ISER holds an example labelled BITSY 2. According to the museum, the workstation, drive and software together cost about DM 25,000.
product.ta-bitsy-2.technical.configurati: The dual unit could handle two disks. The ISER example has two 8-inch drives rated at 1,340 KB each.
product.ta-bitsy-2.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-bitsy-2.technical.limitations: The boot ROM and a working-system test remain pending.
product.ta-bitsy-2.technical.source_1: ISER / FAU · Objekt des Monats · BITSY 2
